disposition_reason: Primary ICP-MS and ICP-OES data for 24 elements in six bee pollen and six propolis samples (per sample, per year and combined) and one royal jelly sample from one west-central Polish apiary.

study.design: Two-season single-apiary survey of beehive products
study.origin: Gory Zlotnickie village, Greater Poland Voivodeship, west-central Poland (Apis mellifera hives)
study.period_text: bee pollen and propolis May 2018 to July 2019 (dates per sample in Tables 1 and 2); royal jelly 2019
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7800) for Ag, Al, As, Ba, Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Mn, Mo, Ni, Pb, Sb, Se, V, Zn; ICP-OES for Ca, Fe, K, Mg, Na, P, S, Si; HNO3 microwave digestion
study.lod_text: Instrumental LOD/LOQ in Supplementary Table S3 (not available)
study.qa: Fortified-sample recoveries within 75-125% and precision per matrix (Supplementary Table S3); no CRM
